category_title: High-achieving dyslexic students using deep-level comprehension strategies
scenario_title: Homework and test preparation using textbook questions
minimal_context: The student is at home trying to answer textbook questions after reading a chapter to prepare for an upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read the chapter and answer the textbook questions to prepare for your test.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I finished reading, but when I try to answer the questions, I find I can't answer them. If I am interested in the material, then I will learn it at once, but if I am not interested in it, then it will take incredibly long to learn it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look back in the text to find the information you missed.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am looking back in the text, but it's not helping me understand. I want to do this together with someone who knows much about it. And who is prepared to work hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to write down the answers yourself first before we do anything else.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't just write them myself. I need you to sit reading in the book aloud to me. Then we talk about the topic afterwards, or you sit taking notes while I tell you about what I have learned.
